Group includes

This value should probably be cached somewhere and only updated when the setting is changed. I say "probably", since the performance impact isn't significant, but most other rendering effects only update the settings on initialization or after they're changed
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/103763 could be used for this once it's ported to 4.x.
I just changed it to only load this setting on project load. I can't think of any realistic use case where it would be necessary to change it at run time.
quality setting changes, resolution changes...

The edge detection threshold doesn't affect quality/performance but is about determining how aggressive you want SMAA to be. For most projects, you'll tweak this based on the project's art direction, rather than performance reasons.

Therefore, I think it's fine to have this setting read only when the project starts. We can change this later if there's a proven need to change it at runtime.

you may still want the user to have an option to pick how aggressive AA they want, also on lower end systems this does have a performance impact still, in cases where the difference between antialiasing is strong, say in cases of full screen dithering or things like that.. Not that you want such cases in a shipping game but it makes for a solid example

FXAA would still beat SMAA in performance by a wide margin on lower end hardware regardless of the configuration.
More flexible configuration options can be made available in the future. I think that this PR should just focus on providing an implementation that will meet the needs of most users and developers.

The setting requires a restart to be effective, even in the editor:

```suggestion
	GLOBAL_DEF_RST(PropertyInfo(Variant::FLOAT, "rendering/anti_aliasing/quality/smaa_edge_detection_threshold", PROPERTY_HINT_RANGE, "0.01,0.2,0.01"), 0.05);
```
It looks like GLOBAL_GET_CACHED() was just implemented. Do you think we should use that for real-time updates, or just leave it as a restart required setting?
I think it's fine to leave as-is (after applying the suggestion).
